name_reason: Trailing '_51a65' is a Ghidra address residual (equals this symbol's own address 0x51a65) and must be stripped per the no-address-suffix rule. The base 'data_fd2_string_resource_filename_fdshap_dat' is fully compliant: data_fd2_ prefix, domain 'string_resource_filename', descriptor 'fdshap_dat' (the FDSHAP.DAT filename literal, which is load-bearing content, not a strippable ID). The adjacent sibling string at 0x51a79 already uses the clean form 'data_fd2_string_resource_filename_fdmus_dat' with no address suffix, confirming the convention. Record-only; rename applied in Stage 2.
purpose: Const filename string "FDSHAP.DAT" passed as the path argument to fd2_load_dat_resource to open the battle scene/shape DAT archive.
logic_summary: Static const char[11] holding the ASCII bytes 'FDSHAP.DAT' + NUL. Its address decays to a char* and is handed to fd2_load_dat_resource (and ultimately fopen(...,"rb")) as the resource container path. Indexing inside that container: scene_id*2 -> battle_scene_snapshot, scene_id*2+1 -> tile_attribute_flags_buffer (scene_id = tile_event_data_table[0]); cinematic routines reload the snapshot via the same string. Pure read-only data; no game-side writer.
element_semantics: ASCII characters of the DOS 8.3 filename "FDSHAP.DAT" followed by a NUL terminator (bytes 46 44 53 48 41 50 2E 44 41 54 00).
notes: All 11 xrefs to 0x51a65 are DATA references (literal pointer-load of the string) from 8 distinct readers: fd2_load_save_and_init_engine (2), fd2_load_chapter_battle_data (2), fd2_chapter_23_end (2), fd2_play_full_combat_cinematic, fd2_play_spell_cast_sequence, fd2_execute_special_attack_skill, fd2_play_figani_char_intro_animation, fd2_execute_summon_spell_cast. The existing src comment block (strtab.c lines 100-115) already lists exactly these 8 readers and correctly states the string is never written and notes the adjacency (follows FDFIELD.DAT @ 0x51A59, precedes DATO.DAT @ 0x51A70); kept as-is. Ghidra data type is already 'string' (len 11). Ghidra plate was null -> created a concise summary via PLATE_COMMENT. No src edit needed (comment keep).
